name: @feiltom/pdfmatrix
description: PDFMatrix: open-source, PDFNet-compatible PDF SDK for Node.js with a Rust core

scripts.build:native: napi build --platform --release --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml --output-dir native --js index.cjs --dts index.d.cts
scripts.build:native:x64: napi build --platform --release --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml --output-dir native --js index.cjs --dts index.d.cts --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu --use-napi-cross
scripts.build:native:arm64: napi build --platform --release --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml --output-dir native --js index.cjs --dts index.d.cts --target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu --use-napi-cross
scripts.build: npm run build:native && npm run build:ts
scripts.build:all: npm run build:native:x64 && npm run build:native:arm64 && npm run build:ts
